visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young boy with short black hair is seen from behind, looking at a tall promotional poster for CREMIA ice cream inside a well-lit shopping mall. (2) The camera pans to reveal the boy's face as he turns slightly; he is wearing a pink and beige t-shirt and brown shorts. An adult's hand enters the frame, pointing at the large image of the soft-serve cone on the poster. (3) The scene shifts to the boy at a wooden service counter. He reaches out to touch a digital ordering screen displaying various ice cream cone options. (4) Close-up shots show the screen menu with categories for original, chocolate, and matcha flavors. The boy points specifically at the screen with interest. (5) The boy is then shown holding a small sample-sized piece of the cat-tongue biscuit cone. He looks down at it curiously. (6) Finally, a person uses a white plastic spoon to scoop a small amount of white soft-serve ice cream from a paper cup and feeds it to the boy, who takes a bite with a neutral but focused expression.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio opens with a soft Mandopop ballad featuring a male singer and acoustic piano. An adult male voice asks a question in a friendly tone, which is immediately followed by the young boy's high-pitched response as he looks at the poster. (2) Background mall noise is very minimal, heard only as a faint atmospheric floor. The child's voice sounds clear and excited. (3) During the ordering phase, the child repeatedly mentions 'ice cream' in Chinese with a soft, breathy vocal quality. The music continues seamlessly. (4) As the child finally tastes the ice cream, a soft metal bump and plastic rustle are heard as the spoon is used. The adult provides gentle encouragement. The music swells slightly towards the end of the clip.
